decision: pass for immutable hashed campaign artifacts; retain active code and manifests on ext4
encryption_visibility: No dm-crypt layer is visible in lsblk for /dev/nvme2n1p3; at-rest encryption is not established by this preflight.
limitations: NTFS/fuseblk is not the preferred native-Linux training filesystem; every retained safetensors artifact must therefore carry a content hash.
The NVMe device advertises a 512-byte discard granularity, but periodic TRIM and mount-level discard were not established.
The direct-I/O probe establishes successful API-level direct writes plus fsync, not independent power-loss durability.
